newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus detains Iranians on drugs suspicion.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus detains Iranians on drugs suspicion.

text.p: Cyprus police said they had arrested on Tuesday three Iranians trying to sell 1.6 kilos (3.5 pounds) of a substance suspected to be opium.
The suspects were arrested in the port city of Limassol, where two of them were spotted by police on a rocky pier hiding a black nylon bag in the rocks, police said in a statement.
The third Iranian, who was keeping a lookout, was arrested after warning shots were fired, a police statement said.
The nylon bag contained a black substance believed to contain opium, it added. The substance is undergoing laboratory tests.
